title: Pure Ancient Fairy Dragon
summary: The 2025 Ancient Fairy Dragon archetype with generic staples. Built around Luna's retrains (Regulus the Fairy Beast, Spore the Fairy Seed and Kuribon the Fairy Spirit), this pure build climbs from Ancient Fairy Dragon into Ancient Fairy Life Dragon under World of Spirits.

summary.title: Starters
points: Regulus the Fairy Beast searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Ancient Fairy Dragon (World of Spirits or Eternal Sunshine) on summon, and Special Summons a Level 4 or lower LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy from your hand in Defense Position.
World of Spirits searches any card that mentions Ancient Fairy Dragon on activation, turning the Field Spell into a second copy of Regulus or Spore.

Spore the Fairy Seed is a Level 1 Plant Tuner that increases its Level by up to 2 when Special Summoned by an effect, and revives itself from the GY while you control Ancient Fairy Dragon or a LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy.

summary.title: Opening: Regulus the Fairy Beast
steps: Normal Summon Regulus the Fairy Beast to search World of Spirits, then activate World of Spirits to search Spore the Fairy Seed.
Use Regulus to Special Summon Spore the Fairy Seed from the hand and raise Spore's Level to 3.
Synchro Summon Ancient Fairy Dragon (Level 4 Regulus + Level 3 Spore), which can destroy and replace the Field Spell to gain 1000 LP and search a second World of Spirits.

Revive Spore the Fairy Seed from the GY at Level 1 and tune it with Ancient Fairy Dragon into Level 8 Ancient Fairy Life Dragon, which draws a card or searches Eternal Sunshine while World of Spirits is on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ancient Fairy Life Dragon (Level 8 Synchro) draws a card on Synchro Summon—or searches a LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy or Eternal Sunshine if World of Spirits is on the field—and allows all your Ancient Fairy Dragon and monsters that mention it to attack while in face-up Defense Position using their DEF (3300 DEF on Life Dragon).

World of Spirits forces every monster Special Summoned from the hand or Deck into Defense Position and destroys all Attack Position monsters on the field during each End Phase, while your monsters stay safe in Defense Position and still attack via Life Dragon.

Eternal Sunshine boosts your monsters' DEF by 500 per World of Spirits and targets an opposing Effect Monster as a Quick Effect up to once per Ancient Fairy Dragon and monster mentioning it you control, halving its ATK/DEF and negating its effects.

summary.title: Support & Protection
points: Kuribon the Fairy Spirit Special Summons itself from the hand as a Tuner while you control Ancient Fairy Dragon or a LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy, and bounces itself to the hand whenever another Ancient Fairy monster would be destroyed by card effect.
Ancient Fairy Dragon (Level 7) can also Special Summon a Level 4 or lower monster from the hand once per turn if you skip your Battle Phase, helping set up turn-1 boards.

main: Starter: searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Ancient Fairy Dragon; summons a LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy.
Tuner: gains Levels as it is summoned; revives itself from the GY.
Summons itself as a Tuner; returns to the hand to save an Ancient Fairy monster.
Field Spell: searches an Ancient Fairy monster; turns summons to Defense and wipes Attack Position monsters.
Continuous Trap: halves and negates a monster once per Ancient Fairy monster you control.
extra: Level 7: summons from the hand and swaps the Field Spell for another.
Level 8 boss: searches Eternal Sunshine or a LIGHT monster with World of Spirits up; attacks with its DEF.
Level 7 option off the same Regulus + Spore line: draws when a Field Spell activated on your turn resolves, and destroys an Attack Position monster while a Field Spell is up.
